newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen continuing rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen continuing rally.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to continue their rally on Monday when the market reopens after Sunday's public holiday, brokers said.
"The market may move up slightly amid fresh commitments of the small investors. The scrips with strong fundamentals are still cheap to attract the investors," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed.
Brokers said the market was unlikely to react significantly to the mounting tension over a storm advancing towards the Bangladesh coast.
